summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the four new After Party features: Party Map (lat/lng + distance_km), Profile Photos (upload + /api/files serving), Invite Links, and Safety (block/unblock/report). All 8 new backend tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py) and the existing regression suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) still passes (25 passed, 3 skipped — same cross-worker xdist skips as prior iterations). All 5 frontend acceptance checks pass at 390x844: (1) feed list ⇄ map toggle works, location-permission-sheet appears on first tap of view-map-button, tapping location-later-button reveals party-map with 6 map-row-<id> items, view-list-button restores party cards; (2) Profile → change-photo-button opens photo-sheet with photo-library-button; blocked-users-row opens blocked-sheet showing blocked-empty state; (3) Swipe → swipe-safety-button → safety-sheet → safety-report-option → report-reason-spam → report-submit-button shows 'Thanks — our team will review this report' toast and sheet closes; (4) /invite/<valid> shows invite-card with invite-party-title='Hackney Loft Afters' and tapping invite-accept-button navigates to /party/<id> with 'You're in — address unlocked' toast; /invite/badcode shows invite-expired; (5) as host (kofi) the party detail shows share-invite-button + invite-card and clicking the card shows 'Invite link copied' toast, while as non-host (test@) the party-safety-button ('...') appears in the header and share/invite elements are absent. No console errors beyond the pre-existing non-blocking react-native-web textShadow*/shadow* deprecation warnings carried over from prior iterations.

action_items: No functional issues found — all 4 new features (Party Map, Profile Photos, Invite Links, Safety) are fully working end-to-end. No main-agent action required.

Carried over from previous iterations (non-blocking): react-native-web still logs 'textShadow*' and 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation warnings; migrate to 'textShadow' / 'boxShadow' shorthands at your convenience.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py party_view (lines 541-543) correctly returns lat/lng as numbers and distance_km=null when caller omits lat/lng, round-1dp when provided — verified by TestPartyMap x3.

POST /api/me/photo (409-435) correctly whitelists image/jpeg|png|webp|heic (rejects text/plain with 400), persists to /api/files/<id>, and GET /api/files/<id> (438-450) streams the exact bytes back with the stored content_type and Cache-Control immutable — verified by uploading a hand-crafted 1x1 red PNG and byte-matching the response.

Invite flow (644-678) correctly 403s non-host /invite requests, 404s bad codes, and the accept path uses do_join(..., invited=True) which bypasses the free 3-joins/day limit (625-629). Also the invite card copy-link path on web works via navigator.clipboard — toast 'Invite link copied — paste it anywhere' confirmed.

Safety: blocked_ids() (461-463) is a bidirectional set that correctly feeds both /parties host_id $nin (574-576) and /discover excluded (696), so blocked hosts' parties and blocked users both disappear from the feed/discover. do_join (623-624) also 403s if host blocks the joiner. Report Pydantic Literal (454-458) returns 422 for invalid reason as required.

Frontend invite-accept-button label is 'Open the party' (not 'Accept') but the testID is correct and tapping it correctly accepts via POST /api/invites/<code>/accept and navigates to /party/<id> with the host-view toast — intentional UX wording; no issue.
seed_data_creation: Test@afterparty.app profile picture was set to a 1x1 red PNG as part of TestPhotoUpload — this is why the Profile avatar now shows a red circle. Also 1 report (reason=spam, target=zara) was filed by test@ user; block was created and then removed so /me/blocks is empty at the end. Fresh test_* users were registered for invite accept and other isolated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new features are fully verified at both the API and UI layer. test@afterparty.app's profile picture is now a 1x1 red PNG from TestPhotoUpload — if a future iteration expects the original Unsplash picture, re-upload via POST /api/me/photo or reset via the seed. test@ user is now attending party_e19aaf55c089 (Hackney Loft Afters) via invite accept done during the UI flow — leave via POST /api/parties/<id>/leave if a test needs a non-attending state. Pre-existing non-blocking react-native-web textShadow*/shadow* deprecation warnings persist in console (not functional). Chat tests (3) in backend_test.py skip under xdist because fresh_user match_id doesn't cross workers — this is the historical status, not a regression.
